messages:
marco: spotting ~12% gpu-attach failures in ap-south1, looks concentrated on a small host set. Anyone else seeing NVMe bursts?

marco: quick dmesg paste from gn-ap-51:
```
[ 2000.100] nvme0: I/O 7 timed out, aborting
[ 2000.101] blk_mq_dispatch: queue 0 stuck, inflight 112
[ 2000.102] nvme0n1: end_request: I/O error, dev 259:0
```

ying: yep, same traces on gn-ap-49/51. I noticed the cleaner job ("ephemeral-cleaner-syncwave") started a coordinated sweep 3m before the spike with concurrency=18.

dina: mitigation: cordoning gn-ap-49 and gn-ap-51 now to stop new attaches, will drain gently.

dina: commands:
```
kubectl cordon gn-ap-51
kubectl drain gn-ap-51 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=90
```

suresh: immediate ops: reduce cleaner concurrency to 2 for ap-south1, pause the scheduled fstrim on affected hosts, and add an attach-router blacklist for 30m. I'll push the config.

ops-bot: Router policy updated: attach-routing (ap-south1 hotlist) -> ap-south2 (canary, 30m).

ying: follow-ups: run SMART quick tests and non-destructive badblocks on those hosts; if reallocated sectors climb or resets >5, plan replacements.

marco: opening INC-5001 to track mitigation, SMART results, and runbook changes (stagger cleaner syncs + default concurrency drop). :spiral_notepad:

suresh: cost note: recommend 3% regional hot spare in AP to avoid capacity hits during these clean waves. Cheaper than retries/customer impact.

marco: status: cordoned 1/2 hosts, cleaner concurrency reduced, attach fallback live. Attach errors trending down. Leaving thread open for SMART results.
